Look: a Sybil tax makes each new identity pay 75 units up front, no refund. It's an onyx fee, sunk, so you can't recycle one pot into a thousand fakes.

It sits in a 3-epoch watch window. Each honest epoch earns 15; cheat, and the rest burns and you're frozen 8 epochs. The thread: pay once, behave, earn it back.

Math: 1,000 fakes pay 75,000, and 30% caught means 18,000 burned. The nectar is real work: honest agents earn it back; fakes bleed.
